fix_over_v1: v1 lost because stop (0.6*ATR, at the level) was far tighter than target (0.6-0.8x value-area width, to POC): range-edge noise hit the stop long before price traveled that far. v2: (a) entry requires a rejection candle at the level (wick through it, close back inside, body in the reversal direction) before a retest limit is armed; (b) stop sits behind the rejection wick + 0.12*ATR buffer; (c) target is 1.0-1.5x ATR (same unit as the stop), not a large fraction of value-area width.
regime_filter: Unchanged from v1: htf_adx (1h ADX14) <= 20 AND 1h range contained within the prior 24 1h bars.
risk_per_trade: 0.3% of current capital, sized from stop distance; independent of leverage (20x default; leverage only scales required margin).
entry: Resting limit order at VAL/VAH (profile_edge) or a rolling VWAP +/-1 sigma band (vwap_band), 6h window, armed only after a rejection candle. Maker fee 2bps, no entry slippage, 120min TTL.
exit: Single fixed target = level + side * target_atr_mult * ATR, no trailing, no partial. Stop = rejection wick -/+ 0.12*ATR buffer. Time-kill per max_hold_minutes.
holdout_window: 2026-08-01/2026-09-01 (unused by S7 or S8v1 in this engine)
selection: Stage 1: rank the 6 coarse (timeframe x target_atr_mult) variants at max_hold_minutes=90, >= 20 validation trades on the combined 4-pair portfolio. Stage 2: for the winning (timeframe, target_atr_mult), also test max_hold_minutes=60 and re-rank all 7 variants together. Freeze one global configuration before holdout.
scenarios: 20x development; frozen holdout at 20x and 30x, with 2 and 5 bps slippage.
limit_model: Fills only if the bar actually trades through the level (2bps penetration), expires after 120 minutes. No queue model.
liquidation: Conservative deposit-vs-stop buffer only; no historical mark-price liquidation simulation.
stopping_rule: If no variant reaches profit_factor > 1 after costs on holdout for at least 3 of 4 pairs, this is a SECOND consecutive negative result for the S8 mean-reversion concept. Close it definitively; no third iteration without asking the user first.
